description: Formal scoring rule for RR directional predictions in CRT calibration
scoring_target_rationale: RR predictions are made about specific catalyst events, not general price direction. Score against whether the predicted catalyst outcome (bullish=HIT, bearish=MISS) matched the actual event resolution.

exogenous_event_rule.label: EXOGENOUS
exogenous_event_rule.description: If the observed price move is driven by an unrelated event (e.g., M&A announcement, unrelated safety signal, macro shock) rather than the predicted catalyst, mark as EXOGENOUS and exclude from the weight-lock gate count.
exogenous_event_rule.example: BIIB bearish RR prediction was about PDUFA. Stock fell 4% on Apellis acquisition instead. Mark EXOGENOUS — do not count as correct bearish call.

BIIB.note: Apr-3 EXOGENOUS (Apellis M&A). May 24 PDUFA observation window expired 2026-07-14 — no clean resolution record after 51 days; dropped per operator instruction.

weight_lock_gate.verdict: INCOMPLETE — 1/3 scorable. BIIB dropped; gate requires 4 clean observations. Extend to next 4-6 predictions before re-evaluating.

fallback_rules.if_all_4_resolved_and_less_than_2_correc: Signal not ready. Reduce mean_rr weight to 0.0 in next candidate.
fallback_rules.if_2_correct_out_of_4: Provisional pass. Extend observation to next 4-6 predictions before weight-lock.
fallback_rules.if_3_or_4_correct: Lock weight. Proceed with promotion evaluation.
